CHIEF COMPLAINT
Left ankle pain

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
36-year-old female presenting with left ankle pain following a fall two days ago. Patient slipped on snow and ice while walking to her car. Her left ankle twisted underneath her, causing her to fall. She experienced immediate pain and significant swelling. Pain is localized to the outside of the ankle and is associated with difficulty walking. Patient denies pain above the ankle, in the calf, lower leg, or knee, and denies bleeding. She has attempted home management with ibuprofen, ice, and elevation with minimal relief.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Denies pain in calf, lower leg, or knee. Denies bleeding.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Type 2 diabetes mellitus
Hypertension
Systolic ejection murmur (2/6, unchanged from prior examination)

MEDICATIONS
Metformin
Norvasc

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient exercises regularly and is eager to return to exercising. Follows dietary restrictions including avoidance of sweets and sugars.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Neck: No bruits
Lungs: Clear
Heart: Normal exam, 2/6 systolic ejection murmur unchanged from prior
Abdomen: Benign
Left ankle: Tenderness over lateral malleolus and fifth metatarsal, swelling, redness, pain with valgus stressing
Sensation: Normal
Pulses: Normal

RESULTS
Blood pressure: 120/70
Hemoglobin A1c: 6.8

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Left ankle injury - ankle sprain versus fracture
   - X-ray of left ankle ordered to rule out fracture
   - Air splint applied
   - Crutches provided
   - Non-weight bearing until x-ray results reviewed
   - Naproxen 500 mg twice daily for pain control
   - Ice and elevation
   - Will contact patient if x-ray shows fracture and refer to orthopedics if indicated
   - If no fracture, will discontinue air splint and trial partial weight-bearing

2. Type 2 diabetes mellitus
   - Continue metformin
   - Keep scheduled ophthalmology appointment (due in next couple of weeks)
   - Hemoglobin A1c ordered
   - Baseline labs ordered
   - Patient to call if any issues

3. Hypertension
   - Norvasc refill provided
   - Continue current management
   - Monitor blood pressure; call if any changes occur
